module: Energy storage type 'fuelTank': liquid fuel tank (gasoline, diesel, kerosene). Energy is stored in joules from the volume in liters, the density and the energy density; the mass of the engine group nodes is adjusted according to the level, and a leak can empty the tank in 60 s if it is punctured. Instantiated by energyStorage.lua for `type = "fuelTank"`.
usage:
local tank = energyStorage.getStorage("mainTank")
tank:setRemainingVolume(20)   -- 20 liters remaining
print(tank.remainingVolume, tank.remainingRatio)
notes: jbeam fields read: name, type, energyType ('gasoline' default, 'diesel', 'kerosene'), fuelCapacity (L), startingFuelCapacity (L, limited to fuelCapacity), energyDensity (J/kg), fuelLiquidDensity (kg/L), breakTriggerBeam, fuel._engineGroup_nodes (nodes whose mass varies with the fuel).

Default values: gasoline 41.5 MJ/kg and 0.75 kg/L; diesel 43 MJ/kg and 0.84 kg/L; kerosene 43 MJ/kg and 0.80 kg/L. An unknown energyType without energyDensity/fuelLiquidDensity in the jbeam gives 0 and will cause divisions by zero in updateGFX.
Units: storedEnergy and energyCapacity in J, remainingVolume in L, brokenLeakRate = capacity / 60 (L/s, drained in 60 s).
The fuelNodes nodes receive every frame the mass = initial mass + storedEnergy * fuelNodeMassCoef (1 / (energyDensity * number of nodes), so fuel mass is distributed).
The leak after a break is not saved: getPartCondition always returns currentLeakRate = 0 in the state but integrityValue = 0 if the tank leaks.
Uses the global `v` (vehicle data) and the engine's `obj:setNodeMass`.

new.desc: Creates the tank instance from the jbeam entry and immediately applies the fuel mass to the relevant nodes.

jbeamData.desc: Merged jbeam data of the storage.

storage.desc: Instance returned by new(jbeamData). Notable public fields: name, type, energyType, storedEnergy (J), energyCapacity (J), initialStoredEnergy (J), capacity (L), startingCapacity (L), remainingVolume (L), remainingRatio (0 to 1), currentLeakRate (L/s), brokenLeakRate, energyDensity, fuelLiquidDensity, assignedDevices.

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame: recomputes remainingVolume/remainingRatio, applies the mass to the nodes and removes fuel if currentLeakRate > 0.

setRemainingVolume.desc: Sets the remaining volume (clamped between 0 and capacity) and updates storedEnergy.

setRemainingRatio.desc: Sets storedEnergy to energyCapacity * ratio (ratio clamped between 0 and 1).

onBreak.desc: Called when a breakTriggerBeam beam breaks: enables the leak (currentLeakRate = brokenLeakRate).

setPartCondition.desc: Restores the state from the part condition (number = fraction of the tank, with a leak if 0; or table {storedEnergy, currentLeakRate}).

getPartCondition.desc: Returns the integrity (0 if leaking, 1 otherwise) and the state {storedEnergy, currentLeakRate = 0}.

reset.desc: Fills the tank to the starting level, removes the leak and reapplies the mass to the nodes.

deserialize.desc: Restores remainingVolume from serialized data (if present).
